headlines.description: Crystal Palace made an impressive start to their debut Europa League campaign by sweeping aside Polish champions Lech Poznan 4-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crystal Palace win big in long-awaited UEL debut

headlines.description: First-half goals by Justin Kluivert and Rayan helped Bournemouth start their maiden European campaign with a memorable 2-1 win at Real Sociedad.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bournemouth make statement in European debut
